diagnosis.hypothesis: Observed only finance1<->app1 connectivity failing while all other tested paths were healthy. On leaf2, both subnets were locally connected and interfaces/addressing were present, but ACL config showed output filter ibn-subnet-guard attached only to ethernet-1/30.0, with a rule dropping destination 10.10.30.0/24. Removed that specific ACL attachment from leaf2 ethernet-1/30.0. Public success criteria then passed: finance1->app1 and app1->finance1 both succeeded, and previously healthy paths remained successful.
diagnosis.reference: On leaf2, a traffic filter drops all traffic to subnet 10.10.30.0/24 (finance_vlan segment), applied on interface ethernet-1/30.

arguments.name: default
arguments.reason: Finance1 and app1 can reach only locally connected subnets on leaf2 while all other inter-subnet paths work; leaf2 has connected routes for 10.10.30.0/24 and 10.10.50.0/24 plus static routes to leaf1, but no default route despite hosting the internet-facing subnet 203.0.113.0/24. A missing default route on leaf2 explains the isolated failure between finance1 and app1 if return traffic toward non-local sources is not forwarded correctly.

final_response.summary: Observed only finance1<->app1 connectivity failing while all other tested paths were healthy. On leaf2, both subnets were locally connected and interfaces/addressing were present, but ACL config showed output filter ibn-subnet-guard attached only to ethernet-1/30.0, with a rule dropping destination 10.10.30.0/24. Removed that specific ACL attachment from leaf2 ethernet-1/30.0. Public success criteria then passed: finance1->app1 and app1->finance1 both succeeded, and previously healthy paths remained successful.
